name: Inline Style Aggregation
description: Collects inline <style> tags from the rendered HTML response and merges them into one <style> in <head>.
project_description:
This module provides grouping of styles in a single tag within the page header.

 For example, if you have several style tags within the body. They will be grouped into a single tag inside the head.

 Before: 

 html

 head

 ...

 body

 div

 ..

 ...

 style

 .style_1{ padding: 1px; }

 div

 div

 style

 .style_2{ padding: 2px; }

 style

 .style_3{ padding: 3px; }

 p

 Lorem...

 div

 ...

 style

 .style_4{ padding: 4px; } 

 After: 

 html

 head

 ...

 style

 .style_1{ padding: 1px; }

 .style_2{ padding: 2px; }

 .style_3{ padding: 3px; }

 .style_4{ padding: 4px; }

 body

 div

 ..

 ...

 div

 div

 p

 Lorem...

 div

 ...
